    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/test_0.csv"
]

for file_path in source_files:
    # Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Date' to match target schema
    df = df.rename(columns={"Text Date": "Date"})
    
    # Select only the columns needed for the target table
    df = df[["Date", "Water Use", "Power Use"]]
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source dataframes (union)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Aggregate by 'Date' because target table has 'Date' as primary key
# Sum Water Use and Power Use as target values are larger than source values (Hint 13)
df_agg = df_all.groupby("Date", as_index=False).agg({
    "Water Use": "sum",
    "Power Use": "sum"
})

# Ensure column types match target schema
df_agg["Date"] = df_agg["Date"].astype(str)
df_agg["Water Use"] = df_agg["Water Use"].astype(float)
df_agg["Power Use"] = df_agg["Power Use"].astype(int)

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/target_multisource.csv"
df_agg.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
